row.title: PROGRESS-1: visible progress at every visit, cadence monitor across systems
row.body: Rowan, 2026-11-20: six months with no input, noticeable progress at every visit on every system. Decision: one fleet page (/progress, digests, Atom, JSON) built only from merged changes, tenant releases and launched apps; the tick step progress judges each system in instances/ultrastable/progress.json against its declared cadence, dispatches its producer workflows when slow and files STALL-<system> when stalled; record-keeping merges never count; a reader's last visit stays in the reader's browser.
